article_body:
St. Vincent–St. Mary and Lutheran West brought their boys basketball programs together during the 2025–26 school year. The tempo of a basketball game creates brief moments that photographs can preserve long after the play ends.

Mason Bybee’s courtside images center the athletes, the mechanics of the game and the environment around the floor. This archival feature does not present unverified scoring statistics.
